name: Zenitron Corporation
summary: Zenitron Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the sale of electrical components in China, Taiwan, and internationally. It offers power supply solutions, telecom and communication solutions, industrial electronics solutions, consumer solutions, and IOT solutions. The company is also involved in the electronic parts and components trading business; sales of computer memory devices, provision of technical support and sale of related parts; and electronic parts and components trading business. Zenitron Corporation was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
